excerpts.content:
Not sure, but I think one of the other services like alchemy/blockdaemon/quicknode might offer one.

You could also run one locally as a better alternative 😄

With checkpoint sync, it'd take seconds and you can get rid of it once you are done. Nimbus even has a new release which lowers space used even for a longer running node😄
